game_name: Street Fighter II': Champion Edition (Japan 920322, UPL bootleg?)
general_issues: Select sf2ceupl.zip; keep parent archives, keys and required qsound.zip beside it. Experimental emulation; profile coverage does not mean full gameplay qualification. Test Menu automatically holds the original UPL debug boot chord (Player 2 Right and Button 3) for 120 frames, then releases it. Press Test to release the startup Test switch. TPO automatically assigns up to 2 computers. Each computer controls one player on the shared cabinet using its Player 1 controls. Rollback uses a canonical two-frame input delay; every linked cabinet and serial queue is restored together. Offline EEPROM and manual cabinet settings are ignored during online play.
